description: This file is an HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer UI, including embedded CSS styles and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying database and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from backend API and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by reloading from API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles expansion of database to show tables, loads tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches raw data for a selected table and renders it into a table view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for the data table, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell, handling objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked, for full text or object display.
